acceptance: four candidates are globally behaviorally distinct
OIA adaptive identity synthesis returns exact solved
minimum worst-case depth is between 2 and 6 inclusive
candidate_generation.first_observation_rule: Every action from initial state s0 emits o0; candidate information can appear only after hidden state transition.
candidate_generation.seed_derivation: first 64 bits of SHA-256 over NUL-framed master seed and generation coordinates

claim_boundary: Controlled deterministic Track A simulation of within-frontier identification and outside-frontier detection under frozen finite candidate sets. No external validation, learned ontology formation, necessary revision, sealed transfer, statistical population inference, comparative superiority, or Track B claim.

comparators.greedy_one_step: At each surviving belief choose the lexicographically tie-broken action minimizing maximum immediate branch size, then sum of squared branch sizes.
comparators.oia_adaptive: Unchanged exact minimum-worst-case full-identity policy synthesized from candidates only.
comparators.uniform_random: Uniform random action at each step from a target-independent SHA-256-derived trial seed; belief updates and outside-branch checks remain exact.

evidence: exact OIA policy hashes, depths, roots, and reachable-belief counts
every action/output trace, terminal classification, and step count
deterministic case manifest and JSONL record hashes
execution.horizon: Each policy receives that case's exact OIA minimum worst-case depth.
execution.policy_target_information: No policy receives target transitions, target hash, or target kind.

primary: OIA outside_model count among 64 outside-target executions
OIA false_candidate_identification count among 64 outside-target executions
outcomes.required_soundness: All 256 in-family OIA executions must correctly identify their candidate; otherwise the benchmark is an instrument blocker.
secondary: equal-horizon greedy outside detection, false identification, and unresolved counts
equal-horizon uniform-random outside detection, false identification, and unresolved counts
per-policy in-family correct and unresolved counts
outcomes.statistics: Exact deterministic counts only; no p-values, confidence intervals, or population generalization.

prospective_ordering: benchmark generator, seeds, filters, policies, horizons, endpoints, and evidence format frozen
future benchmark case generation and target execution
future immutable outcome packaging and verification
stop_rules: Stop with a generation blocker if any case exhausts 2000 attempts.
Stop with an instrument blocker if any accepted OIA policy is not exact and solved.
Stop with an instrument blocker if any in-family OIA execution is not a correct candidate identification.
Do not change generator, filters, seeds, horizon, comparator, or endpoint definitions after benchmark execution; defects require a new numbered slice.
